validity.researcher_notes: The line is real and operating. The wiki link on this row points to the Central Brazil Gas Pipeline page by mistake, so all 18 citations harvested for this row are about Brazil. The research used the citations of the Torzhok to Minsk to Ivatsevichi page instead. The capacity of 40 bcm per year is a figure for the whole three string system and is left unconfirmed.

verifications.note: The company history says the second string began work in 1978

fills.researcher_notes: The company history dates the second string to 1978. The sheet start year 1978 stands.
Sources give about 40 bcm per year for the whole three string system. No source gives a figure for the second string alone. The sheet value stays and is not confirmed.

verifications.note: Table row says 851 km each, 3 strings

fills.researcher_notes: A table of gas transport projects lists 851 km for each of three strings, so 851 km applies to the second string. The table is an archived copy of a page that no longer loads.

Report gives 1220 mm for the line

fills.researcher_notes: The company activities page and a 2023 report both give 1220 mm for the three string line.

verifications.note: Page names the company as operator of the line

fills.researcher_notes: The activities page of Gazprom Transgaz Belarus says the company runs the line. The operator on the sheet stands.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The company activities page of May 2025 lists the three string line among the pipelines it runs. Status operating stands.
